supersedesDeployment.note: v0.2 proved that a receipt-shaped input is deterministically disposed into a proposal and a gated settlement. It did NOT prove authenticated GenLayer adjudication: the settled receipt carried source_contract 0xabc000000000000000000000000000000000001, a placeholder registered nowhere. This deployment stays historical and is NOT upgraded in place.

problemStatement: v0.2 accepts any syntactically valid owner-supplied receipt JSON as origin-authenticated. `source_contract` is a self-asserted string; no registry, sender binding, or authority fingerprint exists. Proven in tests/ppa receipt origin spec: unregistered source yields ACTIONABLE receipt, admitted proposal, and settlement. Bounded today only because _resolve_actor admits the owner and the owner can already call send() directly. Becomes privilege escalation the moment custody, bridges, a frontend badge, a conformance lane, or an external counterparty trusts the receipt as authority.
rootCause: Receipt provenance was never part of the v0.2 admission path. _validate_receipt checked shape, vocabulary, and expiry window only. An adjudicator that writes its own address into caller-supplied JSON is not a provenance mechanism; the caller can write any address.

securityModel.originBinding: gl.message.sender_address compared against an owner-registered adjudicator; a JSON source_contract field is never sufficient
securityModel.preferredMechanism: the registered adjudicator contract calls submit_decision_receipt directly, so origin is the actual invoker
securityModel.rejectedMechanism: caller asserts source_contract inside receipt JSON, or an authority fingerprint supplied by the caller
securityModel.residualRisk: Origin binding establishes attributability, not correctness. A registered-but-compromised adjudicator can still emit ACCEPTED for a false conclusion. Registration pins an authority fingerprint and revocation exists for that reason.

gasGate.why: v0.3 adds registry methods, a storage field, and origin verification to a contract already near the Bradbury per-tx ceiling. Adding code may not deploy at all.
gasGate.model: gas = 919311 + 715.0 * inputBytes (validated on 11 successful deploys, max error 0.01%, plus the v0.2 spine deploy at 0.11%)
gasGate.requirement: Before any deployment attempt, eth_estimateGas the exact deploy encoding for the v0.3 contract. If the estimate exceeds 16.7M, classify DEPLOY_BLOCKED_GAS and STOP.
gasGate.onBlock: Do not walk gas caps. Report the shortfall and open the modular-split work (registry and/or proposal adapter extracted to a second contract) as separate authority under a new Work Contract.

result.consequence: Implementation is complete and locally green. Deployment is blocked. Open the modular split as a separate authority; do not re-attempt this source shape and do not walk the gas cap or remove annotations.

ceilingCorrection.consequence: DEPLOY_BLOCKED_GAS was the wrong verdict for the monolith. The split (WORK-PPA-SPLIT-V03-2026-10-17) supersedes this work on architectural grounds, not gas grounds.

dependencies: Adjudication producer contract is OUT OF SCOPE for this work. This contract only makes a receipt origin-attributable and refuses unattributable ones. The producer may not be built until this lands, because a producer whose receipts are not origin-checked is bypassable and therefore inert.

toolingFindings.lane: tools/ -- OUT OF SCOPE for this Work Contract, not fixed here
toolingFindings.finding: tools/nomos_run_vectors.py reads vector['actions']. A vector with no 'actions' key is iterated zero times and reported PASS. Proven: a vector whose 'steps' contained an impossible assertion reported PASS, while the same assertion under 'actions' reported FAIL.
toolingFindings.impact: 6 vectors across 2 primitives reported conformance green while executing zero assertions. claim-verification is CONFORMANT, so part of its conformance evidence is vacuous.
toolingFindings.recommendation: Open a separate Work Contract against tools/. Minimum fix: fail a vector that declares no executable actions, so a schema mismatch can never report PASS.
